title: Stripe Failed Payment Dunning
summary: Detect Stripe payment failures, apply retry and escalation rules, update HubSpot, send Slack alerts, and draft a customer email needing approval before sending.
primaryKeyword: stripe failed payment slack alert hubspot
seoTitle: Stripe Payment Failure Dunning with HubSpot and Slack
answer: This template listens for Stripe invoice.payment_failed webhooks, applies configurable retry and escalation rules based on failure count and invoice amount, looks up the customer in HubSpot, updates a payment status property, posts a Slack alert to the billing team channel with per-run deduplication, and drafts a customer-facing email with payment retry instructions. The drafted email requires manual approval before sending, preventing automated messages from going out during sensitive situations.

faq.a: Stripe offers Smart Retries and email templates for failed payments, but it does not integrate with your CRM, Slack alerts, or require manual approval before customer emails are sent. This template combines payment failure detection, CRM updates, team notifications, and controlled customer communication in one workflow.

faq.q: How do retry and escalation rules work?
faq.a: The code step checks the failure count and invoice amount. For example, failures 1 to 2 trigger internal Slack alerts only, failure 3 sends a customer email draft for approval, and failure 4 escalates to a high-priority Slack ping with executive visibility. You can customize these rules in the apply_dunning_rules step.

faq.q: Why does the customer email require approval?
faq.a: Manual approval prevents automated emails from reaching customers during disputes, temporary card issues, or when a renewal conversation is already in progress. The drafted email appears in your Gmail drafts folder for review and editing before sending.

faq.q: What information is updated in HubSpot?
faq.a: The workflow updates a custom payment_status property on the contact or company record (e.g. payment_failed, retry_scheduled, escalated) and logs a note with failure details. You can create additional workflows in HubSpot that trigger on this property change.

faq.q: What happens if the customer is not found in HubSpot?
faq.a: The workflow logs a warning and still posts the Slack alert with Stripe customer details. The email draft is not created since there is no contact email to address it to.

sampleOutput: Slack message: Payment Failed: Acme Corp invoice $499 declined (3rd attempt). HubSpot updated. Customer email drafted for review in Gmail. Draft ID: 18f1a2b3c4d5e6f7.
whatYouNeed: Stripe integration connected in Ballet, HubSpot integration connected with custom payment_status property on contacts and companies, Slack Bot integration connected and invited to billing alerts channel, Gmail integration connected
failureHandling: The Stripe webhook responds immediately to avoid timeouts. If HubSpot, Slack, or Gmail API calls fail, the workflow retries automatically. Failed runs appear in history with error details.
nativeVsTemplate: Use Stripe's built-in dunning when you only need automatic payment retries and templated emails. Use this template when you need CRM integration, Slack alerts, escalation rules tied to invoice value and failure count, and manual approval for customer emails to maintain control over sensitive billing communications.
setup: Connect the Stripe, HubSpot, Slack Bot, and Gmail integrations in Ballet once.
In HubSpot, create a custom contact property 'stripe_payment_notes' (single-line text) under Settings > Properties > Contact Properties to store payment failure notes.
Create a custom HubSpot property called payment_status (text field) on contacts and companies.
Invite the Slack bot to your billing alerts channel.
Publish the playbook and copy the webhook URL from Studio.
In Stripe dashboard, add the webhook URL and subscribe to invoice.payment_failed events.
Test by creating a test invoice with a declined test card and watching the run.
